module: Flowgraph node "Set Recovery Prompt Button" (category once_instant). Creates or modifies a recovery prompt button via core_recoveryPrompt.addButton. Input pins: buttonId, label (default "Button"), order (leave empty = added at the end), fadeActive (hidden, default true: screen fade), icon (icon id).

workOnce.desc: Calls core_recoveryPrompt.addButton with buttonId, label, an empty function (nop), order, fadeActive and icon.
